description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/treasury/auctions (base $0.003; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Each auction: CUSIP, term, announcement, auction and issue dates, offering amount. Recent auctions add high yield, bid-to-cover and allotments. Sources: TreasuryDirect auctions JSON API and the Fiscal Data Treasury securities auctions dataset. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Treasury. Not investment advice. Bad input or an unavailable source: Not charged. USDC on Base or Polygon. On USDC on Base, errors are not charged, apart from the exceptions noted on a route.
